offers_products.reason: Manufactures paint protection film, window tint, ceramic coatings and sells them through installers and distributors.

offers_services.reason: Also operates company-owned installation shops (and fleet/dealer installation services), a smaller part alongside product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Vehicle owners choose XPEL films for their cars, boats and homes, installed through installers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells film to independent installers, distributors, dealerships and automaker partners like Rivian and BMW.

recurring_revenue.reason: Installers and distributors repeatedly reorder film rolls and consumables, though end consumers buy once.

cyclical_demand.reason: Aftermarket vehicle protection and tint are discretionary and tied to new-car sales; easy to postpone.

big_ticket.reason: Film rolls are reordered frequently by installers; installs cost hundreds to few thousand dollars, a modest purchase.

people_delivered.reason: Value comes from manufactured films and coatings, not staff time; installation is a smaller part.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are independent installers, distributors and car owners; automakers and dealer groups are a smaller share.

asset_heavy.reason: Films are made by contract manufacturers and sold via installers; the company needs modest facilities and few owned assets.

notes: Website text does not describe the business mix; split between products and services is based on general knowledge of XPEL.
